_comment: SOP Builder catalog. Each tool maps to one or more Procore module ids (matching data.json) so the builder only shows tools the selected ERP actually syncs. {ERP} is replaced with the selected connector's label at render time. Actions become the default 'Roles & Responsibilities' rows; users assign Name + Project Role + Permission Level and can edit/add rows. keyConfigs and fieldsets are tool-specific and apply to whichever connector (Procore-native or Agave) syncs that tool. Sync direction + best-practice notes are pulled live from data.json per ERP.

tools.title: Budget
tools.overview: Real-time comparison of the project budget against committed cost across the construction lifecycle, aggregating budget and cost-tool data for accurate cost-to-complete analysis and over/under forecasting.
actions: Add cost codes at the Project level.
Import or create the internal project budget (Excel import, manual line items, or {ERP} sync).
Confirm budget accuracy and lock the budget.
Own ongoing budget performance and the Forecast-to-Complete.
Take budget snapshots on the agreed cadence (biweekly / monthly).
Create internal budget changes (net-zero) and run the Budget Changes report.
Review and Accept / Reject the budget for export to {ERP}.

keyConfigs.note: Assumes the full budget line item will be spent unless a manual or lump-sum forecast is entered.
Unlocks the Forecasting view and lump-sum forecast entry.
Forces internal budget changes to balance to zero.

keyConfigs.setting: ERP budget settings (Transaction Detail, Forecast sync, Billed Rate, Accumulate As)
keyConfigs.note: Confirm how transaction detail and billed rate accumulate from the connected ERP.

tools.title: Commitments (Subcontracts & Purchase Orders)
tools.overview: Track and manage the real-time status and value of all subcontracts and purchase orders, including schedules of values, compliance items, and subcontractor invoicing.
actions: Add companies / vendors receiving a contract to the Project Directory.
Create Commitments (Subcontracts and Purchase Orders).
Check compliance items (insurance, permits, licenses) before release.
Create the Schedule of Values (SOV) per contract.
Send commitments to subcontractors / vendors and update status when issued and signed.
Approve subcontractor invoices.
Send commitments to {ERP} and sync once compliance is met.

keyConfigs.setting: Number of Commitment Change Order tiers
keyConfigs.note: Cannot be changed after the first change order is created on the project.
Default deadline for vendor RFQ responses.
Opt in to allow field-initiated change orders.
Enable per commitment to let subcontractors enter their own SOV breakdown for approval.
Add users for automatic distribution and invoice 'Under Review' notifications.

tools.title: Change Management
tools.overview: Track potential scope impacts and manage the full change process — Change Events, RFQs, Potential Change Orders (PCO), Prime Contract Change Orders (PCCO), and Commitment Change Orders (CCO).
actions: Manage project Change Orders and verify accuracy (status, amounts, schedule impact).
Create Change Events.
Create and send Requests for Quote (RFQs) and review responses.
Create the Potential Change Order (PCO) and Prime Contract Change Order (PCCO).
Create the Commitment Change Order (CCO).
Accept / Reject the PCCO for export to {ERP}.

keyConfigs.setting: Number of Prime Contract Change Order tiers
keyConfigs.note: 1-tier: Change Event to PCCO. 2-tier: Change Event to PCO to PCCO. Cannot change after the first CO.

keyConfigs.setting: Show Line Items on PCCO / CCO PDFs
keyConfigs.note: Includes change-order line items on exported PDFs.

keyConfigs.setting: Allow Standard users to create PCOs
keyConfigs.note: Leave off unless standard-permission users must create Potential Change Orders.

keyConfigs.setting: Copy attachments from RFQ responses to PCOs / CCOs
keyConfigs.note: Carries RFQ attachments into new change orders.

keyConfigs.setting: Maintain Budget Codes across line items in sync
keyConfigs.note: Keeps budget code and description synced across linked change objects.
Add users for automatic change-order distribution.

tools.title: Direct Costs
tools.overview: Track direct costs (expenses and invoices) not associated with commitments — such as general conditions and self-performed work — for a complete picture of project costs impacting the budget.
actions: Import or create cost postings in the Direct Cost tool.
Review and validate all project direct costs.
Reconcile {ERP}-synced costs (payroll, expenses, non-commitment invoices) on the agreed cadence.

keyConfigs.note: Disable if the ERP posts costs directly to the budget Job-To-Date column instead of the Direct Cost tool.
Pulls payroll, expenses, and non-commitment invoices from the ERP into Direct Costs.
Defines how labor posts (owner billing rate vs. average cost) and how costs accumulate.
Set how often direct costs are imported to keep budget forecasting accurate.

tools.title: Prime Contract
tools.overview: Manage the upstream owner contract, its schedule of values, owner invoices / billings, and prime contract change orders.
actions: Create and maintain the Prime Contract and its Schedule of Values.
Manage owner invoices / billings against the Prime Contract.
Obtain owner signatures (DocuSign or manual) and track execution.
Send the Prime Contract and PCCOs to {ERP} and Accept / Reject for export.

keyConfigs.setting: Number of Prime Contract Change Order tiers
keyConfigs.note: Determines owner change-order steps; cannot be changed after the first owner CO.

keyConfigs.setting: Allow Standard users to create PCOs
keyConfigs.note: Grants standard users the ability to create PCOs on the Prime Contract.

keyConfigs.setting: Enable Always Editable Schedule of Values
keyConfigs.note: Allows the SOV to be edited after invoices exist — use with caution.

keyConfigs.setting: Show Markup on Invoice PDF and CSV
keyConfigs.note: Controls whether financial markup is exposed to the owner on invoices.
Add users for automatic prime-contract distribution.
Configure if tracking multiple funding sources on the contract.

tools.title: Timesheets
tools.overview: Capture, review, approve, and complete field time (Timesheets and MyTime) for export to the accounting system.
actions: Enter crew time via Timesheets and track production quantities daily.
Mark timesheets as Reviewed (project / company level).
Mark timesheets as Approved (project / company level).
Mark timesheets as Completed (company level).
Import Completed timesheets to {ERP} on the agreed cadence.

keyConfigs.setting: Time Types matched to ERP Payroll / Earn Codes
keyConfigs.note: Procore Time Types must match the ERP's payroll items / earn codes for timecards to export.

keyConfigs.setting: Review then Approve then Complete workflow
keyConfigs.note: Reviewed (foreman/super, project or company), Approved (admin), Completed (company level).
Company-level Standard permission is needed to review/approve at the company level.
